description: This file defines the class ViewBufferTextWriterContent, which extends TextWriter and implements IHtmlContent. It manages writing HTML content efficiently to a buffer, utilizing pooled StringBuilder instances, and provides methods for writing various data types asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: ViewBufferTextWriterContent
classes.description: A TextWriter implementation optimized for writing to ASP.NET ViewBufferTextWriter, supporting pooled StringBuilder buffers and HTML content writing.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a string to the buffer, handling buffer capacity and renting new buffers as needed.

methods.name: Write(char)
methods.description: Writes a single character to the buffer, allocating a new buffer if capacity is exceeded.

methods.name: Write(char[])
methods.description: Writes a character array to the buffer, managing buffer capacity.

methods.name: Write(char[], int, int)
methods.description: Writes a portion of a character array to the buffer.

methods.name: Write(ReadOnlySpan<char>)
methods.description: Writes a span of characters to the buffer.

methods.name: Write(StringBuilder)
methods.description: Writes content from a StringBuilder to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteTo
methods.description: Outputs the buffered content to a TextWriter, optionally releasing buffers after writing.

methods.name: FlushAsync
methods.description: Overrides to provide a completed task, as flushing is handled internally.
